mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.perm_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id AS partnerId, u.username AS partnerUsername, u.nickname AS partnerNickname, f.file_url AS partnerAvatar, r.role_code AS partnerRoleCode, m.content AS lastMessage, m.send_time AS lastMessageTime FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS partnerId, MAX(id) AS lastMsgId FROM im_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY partnerId ) conv JOIN im_message m ON m.id = conv.lastMsgId JOIN user u ON u.id = conv.partnerId LEFT JOIN file f ON u.user_file_id = f.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.id ORDER BY m.send_time DESC
